description: ADCOS Link object: a directional or bidirectional connectivity relationship between two adapters. Link state is an independent topology dimension, never collapsed with identity, advertisement freshness, or reachability (spec/architecture.md §6.5, §11, LOCK-009). The state enum is frozen as the §11 Link dimension DOWN | DEGRADED | UP.

adapters.description: The two adapter references joined by this link.

state.description: Link state dimension (architecture §11); independent of node identity and advertisement freshness.

title: ADCOS Link
